central_topic: Indus-Sarasvatī / Harappan Civilisation, Town Planning, Trade, and De-urbanisation

nodes.title: The Beginnings of Indian Civilisation
nodes.summary: India's earliest planned urban civilisation flourishing in river basins.

nodes.title: Urban Architecture & Engineering
nodes.summary: Advanced town planning, uniform brick ratios, and fortified civic sectors.

nodes.title: Public Works & Hydraulic Monuments
nodes.summary: Bitumen waterproofing, tidal docks, and massive rock-cut water storage.

nodes.title: Economy, Craft & Long-Distance Trade
nodes.summary: Craft specialization, standardized weights, and trade with Mesopotamia.

nodes.title: De-urbanisation & Environmental Shifts (~1900 BCE)
nodes.summary: Climatic changes forcing urban abandonment and transition to agrarian villages.
